import numpy as np
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact

# === 1. obs_only vs argmin (pooled) ===
# obs_only: 105/600, argmin: 74/600
table1 = [[105, 600-105], [74, 600-74]]
odds1, p1_two = fisher_exact(table1, alternative='two-sided')
_, p1_one = fisher_exact(table1, alternative='greater')

# Cohen's d (pooled proportions)
p_obs = 105/600
p_arg = 74/600
p_pool1 = (105+74)/(600+600)
d1 = (p_obs - p_arg) / np.sqrt(p_pool1*(1-p_pool1))

print('=== obs_only vs argmin ===')
print(f'obs_only: 105/600 = {p_obs:.4f}')
print(f'argmin:    74/600 = {p_arg:.4f}')
print(f'Fisher exact p (two-sided): {p1_two:.6f}')
print(f'Fisher exact p (one-sided): {p1_one:.6f}')
print(f'Cohen d (effect size h): {d1:.4f}')
print()

# === 2. obs_only vs VLA-only (pooled) ===

vla_successes = 12+12+10+9+13
print(f'VLA-only successes: {vla_successes}/500 = {vla_successes/500:.4f}')

_, p2_one = fisher_exact(table2, alternative='greater')

p_vla = vla_successes/500
p_pool2 = (105+vla_successes)/(600+500)
d2 = (p_obs - p_vla) / np.sqrt(p_pool2*(1-p_pool2))

print(f'VLA-only:   {vla_successes}/500 = {p_vla:.4f}')
print(f'Fisher exact p (two-sided): {p2_two:.6f}')
print(f'Fisher exact p (one-sided): {p2_one:.6f}')
print(f'Cohen d (effect size h): {d2:.4f}')
print()

# Also compute Cohen's d using paired t-test style (per-seed means)
